main_text.l: poftea per crafin pronuntiatum eft, ὁμοούσιον, ad tollendas & euitandas Acatianorum technas, qui vna tantùm diphthongo οι adiecta ex ὁμοού-σιον, ὁμοιούσιον fecerant, ne diuerfa fentire à Nicena fynodo perciperentur, dum Homoufion ore proferrent. Socrat. lib.i. cap.8: 4.cap.ii: 3. cap.7. Effe autem ὁμοούσιον τῷ πατρὶ[?] Filium Patri fic docebant, & interprctabantur orthodoxi patres, vt & Deus verus & æternus, & Patri con-essentialis[?] effe Filius perfpicuè intelligeretur. Hæc ipfa vox poftea variis fynodis orthodoxorum & recepta & probata eft, imprimis OE-cumenicis conciliiis:fed iis quoque fynodis quæ Nicenæ proximæ fuerunt, qualis Alexandrina, quæ ab Athanafio & Eufebio collecta eft: & Sardicenfi, quæ ab Imperatore. Aduerfus Arianos vocem οὐσίας introduxerunt Patres, quemadmodum ad iugulandum Sabellianorum errorem, vocem ὑποστάσεως, Socrat. lib.3.cap.7. Quæ cum effent fcitè & pie & doctè conftituta, exiterunt non tantùm curiofi, fed etiam audaces & impij homines, qui primùm hac ὁμοούσιε vocem nufquam in Scriptura legi cotenderent. Atqui, vt refpondent Patres, & rectè, perinde eft, cum res ipfa quæ hac voce denotatur, diferte extet. Deinde obiecerunt, fi ὁμοούσιον recipiatur, aperte plures Deos conftitui. Hæ fuerunt præcipuæ hoftium rationes, vt fcribit Socrat. lib.i. cap.23.& 2.cap.40. Atque vt poftremæ refpondeatur, maximè vnus tantùm Deus effe docetur, cùm tres illæ hypoftafes, non folùm ὁμοιού-σιοι, fed quod longè plus eft, ὁμοίους esse demonstrantur, iuxta illud Christi, Ego & Pater vnum

page.notes: Greek words are copied as far as legible; the Greek after "Effe autem" and the Greek ending "ὁμοιού-" in "solum" have doubtful letters and are marked [?] where uncertain. "con-essentialis" at the line break is a doubtful reading (the scan shows "effentialis" after the hyphen). The printed "conciliiis" and the mixed "ὁμοίους" forms are left as printed. The Greek after "ὁμοιού-" on the last line, and "hac ὁμοούσιε" with the final letter, are uncertain. Faint marks at the lower left corner are not printed text and are omitted.
